pages.title: African Buffalo
pages.text: The African buffalo ($(o)Syncerus caffer$()) is a large bovine native to sub-Saharan Africa, found in savannas, grasslands and forests near water.$(br2)It is highly social, living in herds that can number in the hundreds and that will band together to defend members against lions.$(br2)In adult males, the bases of the horns meet across the forehead to form a heavy bony shield known as a boss.
